Alex (CEO): Quick weekly note — high level.
Alex (CEO): TL;DR: EU private beta goes live next week, small canary rollback last night, cost optimizations showing progress.
Alex (CEO): 1) Launch: EU private beta scheduled Wed — keep rollout at 10% traffic for first 48h. Maya/Lina, confirm KMS and contract checklist by Tue EOD.
Alex (CEO): 2) Reliability: we had a canary rollback on v2-inference due to a KV-cache invalidation pattern at high seq lengths. Jon, need a short postmortem + mitigation plan by EOD.
Alex (CEO): 3) Cost/ops: Redwood Optimize suggestions look promising — projected monthly GPU spend down ~11% if we accept profiles. Lina, advise on commit vs on-demand tradeoffs.
Maya (VP Product): Noted. EU beta checklist includes feature flags, residency docs, smoke-test matrix. Smoke run Tue 10:00 PDT.
Jon (EngSRE): Quick summary of the canary issue: rolling kernel change + edge seq pattern -> cache miss cascade -> p95 spike. Hotfix: rollback to previous kernel; PR #452 contains the fix. Short logs: 
```
ERROR kvcache: miss at seq 512
TRACE runtime: kernel_dispatch -> fallback_path
```
Jon (EngSRE): Canary metrics snapshot: p95 160ms -> 210ms during the spike; CPU on pool-a spiked 45%. Automated canary policy triggered rollback at ~04:12Z.
Lina (Finance): Cost update: the Optimize recommendations reduce projected monthly GPU spend by ~11% for hosted workloads. Reserve request: additional 8 GPUs for Dedicated to cover EU demand peak — submitted a signoff request.
Alex (CEO): Three concrete asks this week: 1) Maya — final EU launch checklist link + signoff, 2) Jon — brief RC timeline + postmortem, 3) Lina — recommend reserve vs burst economics.
Maya (VP Product): Will share checklist link here: https://internal.redwood/launch/eu-beta. I'll attach the smoke test results after Tue run.
Jon (EngSRE): I'll post the postmortem to #postmortems and include replay instructions + regression test cases.
DeployBot: Deployment v2-inference rollback triggered by automated canary policy at 2026-03-22T04:12Z :warning:
Alex (CEO): FYI — quarter goals reminder: p95 latency target <=180ms for hosted 'redwood-small' profile and reduce unit GPU cost by 8% vs last quarter. We'll review progress on Friday.
Alex (CEO): Quick wins to prioritize this sprint: (a) enable prefix/KV caching for top 10 high-rate customers, (b) apply recommended quantization profile for batch-embedding jobs, (c) tighten canary thresholds for kernel rollouts.
Maya (VP Product): :thumbsup: I'll prepare a 10-min demo for Friday's review slot showing smoke test results and rollout plan.
Lina (Finance): Reserved GPU signoff request has been submitted to procurement; ETA decision Wed.
Jon (EngSRE): Adding replay of canary traffic to the postmortem, and will include a script to reproduce locally.
Alex (CEO): Thanks all. If anything blocks the EU rollout or the reserved GPU decision, ping me directly. Small ask: keep the launch rate conservative until we confirm KV-cache patch stability. — Alex
